reviews.title: Great CPU Fans at great price!
reviews.comment:
I absolutely adore the way it looks and it lifts up high enough it clears room for RAM. I was looking for a decent Air Cooler as wanted something reliable that if does break is easy to replace and fix. What even better is it looks super nice and isn’t loud at all.
I don’t do any crazy gaming or too intense work so this works well fitting into my new PC perfectly. It keeping the temps at 32C and this is me lacking the intake fans(be careful when buying used folks). Highly recommend it for a decent air cooler and enjoy the little LCD telling me the temps. Had to download the software it works great.
P.S don’t worry will be getting some more intake fans on the front but the fact it doing well with exhaust and bottom intake is great!
reviews.author: Yoly

reviews.title: Timeless and modern
reviews.comment:
The Phantom Spirit 120 looks absolutely stunning in a white build PC. Its a bulky beast when it comes to air cooler but that's how you know it does its job very well. The rgb customizable accents on the fans along with the led temp display makes air coolers less dated and more modern as well so it's definitely a timeless piece whereas you will most likely have to replace your liquid cooling setup every 3-5 years.
On my setup I attached the fan on the left side near the rear end of the case because I wanted to still see the ram sticks. It would have blocked it if fans were placed on the other side.

reviews.title: Air cooling now
reviews.comment: Had three AIO quit working a little after a year each, read that the air cooling has gotten better  so I thought I would try it this one seems to be nice the only thing I don't like is the software, on the box it shows you the CPU and the GPU at the same time but software doesn't allow you to do that, noise level is a little bit higher than an AIO. Hoping this lasts a lot longer than a year
